# Quotation response -- DKS-2026-007

Visakoivu Oy, Jyvaskyla

## 3. Eligibility

3.2 Visakoivu Oy's equity ratio, per our most recent financial statements, stands at 35.2%, well above the required 20%.

3.3 Visakoivu employs 48 sahko (electrical) professionals in its own workforce, exceeding the required minimum of 15.

3.4 Visakoivu holds a valid Urakkavarmenne Varmennettu Toimittaja certificate, current at the time of this quotation.

## 4. Technical requirements

4.1 Our proposed HVAC (LVI) maintenance agreement covers scheduled preventive rounds and corrective callouts for all mechanical plant on site.

4.2 A site-specific occupational safety plan will be produced for the facility prior to contract start, covering access routes, permit-to-work procedures and hazard identification specific to a data-centre environment.

4.3 Fire-protection systems will be maintained on a scheduled inspection and testing regime meeting statutory intervals.

4.4 Equipment installed under the contract carries a 24-month warranty from commissioning.

4.5 Waste generated on site is segregated at source and disposed of through licensed contractors, with documentation supplied to the buyer.

4.6 Service continuity through changes in our own personnel is supported by our rakennusautomaatio (building automation) team of 25, giving sufficient depth that no single engineer's absence affects site coverage, together with documented handover procedures between assigned staff.

4.7 Spare parts held in stock cover the majority of routine failure modes; parts not held are typically delivered within 3-5 working days.

4.8 Environmental matters during the works are managed under our environmental management system.

4.9 Our personnel will observe the buyer's access-control and site-security procedures, including badge issuance, visitor logging and any escort requirements specified at induction.

## 5. Commercial terms

5.1 Visakoivu's standard limitation-of-liability clause caps liability at the annual contract value per claim.

## 6. Enclosures

6.1 A description of Visakoivu's environmental management system is enclosed.

6.2 A certificate of Visakoivu's pension insurance payments is enclosed.

## 7. Format

7.1 Pricing is quoted per square metre.

7.2 This quotation is submitted as a single PDF, not password-protected.

7.3 Prices are quoted in EUR per square metre per year.

## Liite A

A.1 We offer SLA targets of 4 hours for critical faults and 24 hours for non-critical faults.

A.2 Our systems are fully compatible with the facility's BACnet/Modbus building automation platform.

A.3 Fault-report response time is 4 hours for critical issues, supported by a 24/7 standby (on-call) rota covering evenings, weekends and public holidays.

A.4 Routine maintenance visits are scheduled monthly for mechanical plant, with content agreed with the buyer in a written maintenance plan.

## Liite B

B.1 We accept a bonus/malus arrangement tied to the service levels in Section 4.

B.3 A list of proposed subcontractors is enclosed as Liite 3.
